CustomField.description: Visual compliance state derived from the stored reason code and non-compliant flag.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Compliance_Reason_Code__c), IF(Non_Compliant__c, "⚠️ Compliance Incomplete", "⚪ Not Evaluated"), IF(Non_Compliant__c, "❌ Non-compliant", "✅ Compliant"))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Distinguishes evaluated compliance from records that have not been evaluated.
CustomField.label: Compliance Indicator
